title: Bihar State Helmet Requirement & Non-BIS Helmet Penalty
description: Riding motorcycle/scooter without helmet or non-BIS certified helmet in Bihar state transport jurisdiction.
violation: Operating or riding two-wheeler without approved BIS protective headgear.
legalSection: Section 194D of MVA 1988 read with Bihar Motor Vehicles Rules

title: Bihar Seat Belt Non-Compliance Penalty
description: Driving light motor vehicle without seat belt on Bihar state roads.
violation: Driving four-wheeler without wearing seat belt.
legalSection: Section 194B(1) of MVA 1988 & Bihar Transport Rules
notes: Applies across all districts of Bihar.

title: Maharashtra Urban Area Parking & Towing Violation
description: Unauthorized parking in designated no-parking areas or obstruction of traffic flow in Mumbai/Pune municipal areas.
violation: Parking vehicle in prohibited zone or near traffic signals.
additionalPenalty: Towing fee of ₹200 (Two Wheeler) / ₹400 (Four Wheeler) extra.
legalSection: Section 177A MVA 1988 read with Maharashtra Motor Vehicles Rules, 1989
sourceName: Maharashtra Motor Vehicles Department / Mumbai Traffic Police
notes: Towing charges levied separately by Traffic Branch.

title: Delhi NCR Misuse of High Beam Headlamps
description: Using high-beam headlamps in illuminated urban roads of National Capital Territory of Delhi.
violation: Operating vehicle with high beam headlamps on lit city roads.
legalSection: Rule 105 of Central Motor Vehicles Rules read with Delhi Traffic Police Directives
sourceName: Delhi Traffic Police / Transport Department Delhi
notes: Dazzling high beam prohibited in city limits.

title: Delhi Silence Zone Pressure Horn Misuse
description: Use of multi-tone/pressure horns or honking in Silence Zones near hospitals, schools, and courts in Delhi.
violation: Honking in silence zone or using illegal modified pressure horn.
legalSection: Section 190(2) MVA 1988 read with CMVR Rule 119
sourceName: Transport Department Govt of NCT of Delhi
governmentDocument: NCT of Delhi Environment & Transport Gazette Notification
notes: Strict enforcement near AIIMS, High Court, and school zones.

title: Karnataka State Helmet Rule (Driver & Pillion)
description: Mandatory helmet rule for two-wheeler driver and pillion rider across Bengaluru and Karnataka state.
violation: Riding without protective headgear for either rider or pillion passenger.
additionalPenalty: License suspension for 3 months for repeat offenders.
legalSection: Section 194D MVA read with Karnataka Motor Vehicles Rules
sourceName: Karnataka Transport Department / Bengaluru Traffic Police
governmentDocument: Karnataka Transport Gazette Notification No. TD 122 TMR 2020

title: Tamil Nadu Speed Limit Violation (City & Highways)
description: Exceeding speed limits posted on Tamil Nadu state highways and Chennai metropolitan roads.
violation: Driving at speed above posted speed limit signs.
legalSection: Section 183 MVA 1988 & Tamil Nadu Motor Vehicles Rules
governmentDocument: Tamil Nadu G.O. (Ms) No. 455 Home (Transport) Department
notes: Speed cameras installed across major highways.

title: Uttar Pradesh Helmet Non-Compliance Penalty
description: Riding two-wheeler without BIS helmet across Uttar Pradesh urban and rural roads.
legalSection: Section 194D of MVA 1988 read with UP Motor Vehicles Rules
notes: Applies across all 75 districts of UP.

title: Gujarat State Reduced Compounding Fee for Helmet
description: Riding two-wheeler without helmet within municipal corporation limits of Gujarat.
legalSection: Section 194D read with Gujarat State Compounding Notification
notes: Compounding fee lowered to ₹500 by state notification.

title: West Bengal Seat Belt Violation (Kolkata & State)
description: Driving car without seat belt in Kolkata Metropolitan Area and West Bengal state roads.
violation: Driving four-wheeler without wearing seat belt.
legalSection: Section 194B(1) MVA read with WB Motor Vehicles Rules
sourceName: West Bengal Transport Department / Kolkata Traffic Police
notes: Enforced by CCTV cameras in Kolkata.
